question: Should design start on patch-release line support — the release.yml line-latestness stamp gate, the stable-branch advance fix, and the automated post-tag preversion bump?

artifacts.summary: Seed from the captain's 2026-08-25 gr/tw reconciliation; the v0.27.0 cut's live incidents are the spec. Three items: (1) the manifest-stamp step gates only on stable-tag shape, so a v0.27.1 tag would stamp main DOWN to 0.27.1 and re-break edge — it must consult line-latestness (the sibling edge-advance job already computes it); (2) the stable-branch advance assumes the tagged commit is on main's history and dies non-FF for a release-branch commit, so stable plugin users never receive the patch; (3) the post-tag main preversion bump is manual ritual step 9 — automate it. Ideation also presents the sequencing options for shipping the #760 fix to stable: v0.27.1 patch line vs fold into v0.28.0. Supersedes next-independent-release-line.
